content: Tasřit iɣḍaren
Yusa-dd ɣari wawař n SIDI, inna:

“Uyur, barreḥ deg umezzuɣ n Urcalim, ini: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Necc ttxarraṣeɣ dayem, di tmexsiwt icewwaren n temẓi nnem, x tayri n wussan n tnexḍabt nnem, umi dd ayi dd-teḍfared di řexřa, di temmurt tamessucit.
Israil tuɣa d amqeddes i SIDI, tamezwarut n ṣṣabet nnes. Marra wi zzayes iccen, iddakkwař dayes řɛib, iwḍa-dd xasen řɣar, ammu i iqqar SIDI.’”
“Sřem i wawař n SIDI, kenniw zi taddart n Yaɛqub, d marra řaǧat n taddart n Israil.
Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Man řɣecc nni dayi ufin řejdud nwem ařami xafi ḥeyyḍen uca ḍfaren l’aṣnam ibeṭṭřen uca dewřen simant nsen di řbaṭeř,

war sseqsin: Mani iǧa SIDI, wenni d aneɣ dd-issuffɣen zi Miṣra, wenni d aneɣ issecnen abrid di řexřa, x ict n temmurt n řexřa d ixendraq, x ict n temmurt n řaẓaɣ d tiři n řmewt, x ict n temmurt war xas iɛdu uřa d ijj u war dayes izdiɣ uřa d ijj n bnadem?
Necc iwyeɣ kenniw ɣar ict n temmurt isseɣmayen ḥima ad zzayes teccem řɣiǧet d řxar. Maca umi din tiwḍem, tessxemjem tammurt inu u tarrim tasɣart inu d jjɛifect.
Ikehhanen war sseqsin: Mani iǧa SIDI?, uca inni tuɣa iḥeṭṭan Ccariɛa war d ayi ssinen u imeksawen ɛeddun-dd xafi u inabiyyen ttnabben s Baɛal uca ḍfaren min war ineffɛen.
S uya Necc ad arniɣ ad mcubbceɣ akidwem, uřa ak-d iḥenjiren n iḥenjiren nwem ad mcubbceɣ, ammu i iqqar SIDI.’”
“Ẓwam ɣar tegzirin n ayt n Kittim, aqa sekkem ireqqasen ɣar Qidar, beytem uca xzarem mliḥ, ma imsar ɛemmarṣ am man aya!
Ma ɛemmarṣ ibeddeř ca n řgens irebbiten nnes, waxxa war ǧin d irebbiten? Řgens inu maca iwca řɛezz nnes deg wemcan n min war ineffɛen.
Iřim d ignawen x man aya, kenniw a ijenwan, ggʷedem, nxeřɛem ař ṭṭarf, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
Maɣar řgens inu igga tnayen n řeɛyub: Necc, Řɛunṣar n waman iddaren, aqa semḥen dayes maḥend ad ɣzan anuten i yixef nsen, anuten s tazzect i ixwan zeg waman.
Ma Israil d ismeɣ niɣ d ijj ittwaru d ismeɣ di taddart? Mayemmi idweř i zzardet xenni?
Ssbuɛruten xas wayraden imeẓyanen, ggin ad sřen i tmijja nsen. Nitni arrin tammurt nnes d ict n řqecɛet n unexřiɛ tineddam nnes ttwasscemḍent ařami war iqqim izeddeɣ daysent uřa d ijj.
Ɛad ḥeffen ayt n Nuf d Taḥfanis aceqquf n uzeǧif nnec.
Ma war teggid ca manawya i yixef nnem, minzi cem tsemḥed di SIDI, AREBBI nnem am Netta indeḥ i cem deg webrid?”
“Řexxu, min din jar am d jar webrid n Miṣra maḥend ad teswed din aman zi Cixur, zeg iɣzar d abarcan? Min jar am d jar webrid n Accur ařami din i ɣa teswed aman n iɣzar n Lfuraṭ?

Tuɛeffna nnem ad cek tarebba u ibriden n uweddar nnem ad cem ɛaqben. Ssen u xzar, mammec war iḥři u mecḥař yarzeg aqa tsemḥed di SIDI, AREBBI nnem, u war zzayi tᵉtteggʷeded, ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat.”
“Aṭṭas zeg wami tarẓid azayřu nnem, tcarrged iceddiyyen nnem. Cem tennid: ‘War xseɣ ad ac sexxareɣ!’ Minzi x kuř řgeɛɛdet yuɛřan u sadu kuř tacejjart tazizawt tuḍared am temɣart n farq-ccɣeř.
Necc maca tuɣa ẓẓuɣ cem d tazayart taḥurrit, d zzariɛet icnan aṭṭas. Mammec tdewřed ɣar tseḍwin n tzayart n řexřa tabarranect?
Waxxa tessirded ixef nnem s llixiyya uca tarnid asray s ṣṣabun, ɛad ad teqqim řmuɛṣiyyet nnem zzat i wudem inu, ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI.”

“Mammec tzemmared ad tinid: ‘Necc war ttwassxemjeɣ ca, necc war ḍfareɣ ca ‘Ibaɛlen!’ Xzar ɣar webrid nnem di teɣzurt, ɛqeř min teggid, cem d tařɣemt tefsus tᵉttazzeř, tenni ittemxarwaḍen deg ibriden nnes!

Aqa-tt d taɣyuč n řexra, innumen di řexřa, tenni ittcemman arriḥ deg wenẓar nnes umi tḥaj. Wi tt i ɣa issbedden di nnecwet nnes? Qaɛ wi tt yarezzun war iḥdij ad issiḥeř ixef nnes, ad tt yaf deg uyur n nnecwet nnes.
Ḥḍa war ittiři uḍar nnem břa tisiřa uřa tmijja nnem war tᵉttiẓeɣ s ufadi! Cem maca teqqared: ‘War xas nessiwiř, ɛemmarṣ! Maɣar necc ɛecqeɣ di midden, xseɣ ad uyureɣ awarni asen!’”
“Am uxewwan inneḥṣeř iseḍḥa, ammu i ɣa seḍḥan inni n taddart n Israil, nitni d ijeǧiden nsen d řḥukkam nsen d ikehhanen nsen d inabiyyen nsen.
Nitni qqaren i ukeccuḍ: ‘Cek d baba!’, u i weẓru: Cek tejjid ayi-dd!, maɣar nitni wcin ayi s weɛrur, war iǧi s uɣembub, maca di řeḥṣaret nsen qqaren: ‘Kkar, senjem aneɣ!’
Mani ǧan řexxu irebbiten nnec, inni teggid i yixef nnec? Ejj i-ten ad dd-kkaren, mařa zemmaren ad cek fekken ɣar řweqt n řeḥṣaret nnec, maɣar irebbiten nwem am lɛadad n tneddam nnec, a Yahuda!”
“Mayemmi akidi temcubbucem kenniw? Kenniw marra tᵉttɛeddam xafi, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
X baṭeř i wtiɣ iḥenjiren nwem, war jjin ixef nsen ad areyyḍen. Ssif nwem icca inabiyyen nwem am wayrad iɣarrṣen.

A kenniw, a jjiř n yiḍa, ḥḍam awař n SIDI. Ma tuɣa ayi d řexřa i Israil, niɣ d tammurt n taǧest d tabarcant? Mayemmi xenni iqqar řgens inu: ‘Aqa neccin nennufṣeř zzayek, war i dd ɣarek neddikkwiř ɛad’?
Ma ad tᵉttu teɛzarect talwizt nnes niɣ ad tᵉttu tesřit taḥezzamt nnes izewwqen? Waxxa amenni i d ayi ittu řgens inu aṭṭas n wussan břa řeḥsab.
Mecḥař tessned mliḥ ad tarzud abrid n tayri? S uya i tessřemded di ibriden nnem timesřayin tiɛeffanin i yixef nnem.
Uřa deg ubeḥrur n warruḍ nnem ufin idammen n řeɛmurat iḍeɛfen izdigen, inni war temniɛed umi ucaren tudrin, wah, zi ssibbet n marra man aya aqa imsar.
Uca ɛad teqqared: ‘S tidett, necc d tamezdagt, aqa aɣḍab nnes iḥeyyed xafi!’ Xzar, Necc ad kim carrɛeɣ, minzi teqqared: ‘Necc war ggiɣ ddnub!’
Mayemmi tᵉtteggʷjed aṭṭas uca tbeddřed řebda abrid nnem? Uřa tammurt n Miṣra ad cem tecmet, am mammec i d am tecmet Accur.
Uřa ssenni ad teggʷejed s ifassen nnem x uzeǧif, maɣar SIDI inḍar marra inni x tᵉttecřed, ařami war ittiři aya uřa akidsen.”

footnotes.text: Kittim- ixs ad yini ‘Qubrus’. Qidar- ict n jjihet n jjwayeh n temmurt n Weɛraben.
Cixur- wanita d isem nneɣni i yeɣzar n ‘Nil’. Cixur ixs ad yini ‘abarcan’, minzi iɣzar n Nil idweř d abarcan zi ssibbet n ubeǧaɛ d ubaryuḍ i dayes iǧan.

zi ssibbet n marra man aya- idammen war uzziřen ca umi ṭṭfen iceffaren niɣ ixewwanen di Israil uca nɣin ten, maca idammen uzzřen umi nɣin inabiyyen n SIDI (xzar 2 Ij. 21:16 u 2 Ij. 24:4). Tuɣa ayt n Israil d ixewwanen d idarɣařen di řmeɛna arruḥani umi ɛebden laṣnam ifennan, war iǧi AREBBI i iǧan i řebda.
